headlines.title_en: Real estate market shows stronger signs of bottoming out and stabilizing, with accelerated transition in development models.
headlines.summary_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, recent in-depth surveys across multiple regions found that the 'stabilizing the housing market' policy continues to show effectiveness, with market confidence and expectations gradually improving, rigid and improvement-oriented housing demand being released in an orderly manner, and the real estate market maintaining a stable trend. 'Reducing inventory' is a key measure to unblock market bottlenecks and release effective supply. From the land perspective, 'controlling quantity and improving quality' became the main theme of the national land market in the first half of 2026. Alongside 'controlling new supply' and 'reducing inventory,' 'optimizing supply' guides new housing supply towards higher quality upgrades, further boosting demand activation.

headlines.title: IMF总裁会见米莱，570亿美元账单到期
headlines.summary: 克里斯塔利娜·格奥尔基耶娃（Kristalina Georgieva）抵达阿根廷首都布宜诺斯艾利斯，亲自考察总统哈维尔·米莱的经济复苏成果。目前阿根廷债券价格上涨，通胀下降，央行正在重建现金储备。格奥尔基耶娃对阿根廷最终有望走出反复借贷的恶性循环表示乐观，并认为在2027年总统大选前，阿根廷无需向IMF寻求额外融资。 阿根廷将于9月开始向IMF偿还本金，还款计划将持续至2042年。IMF前官员表示，米莱若想彻底摆脱对IMF的依赖，几乎需要所有环节都万无一失。

headlines.title_en: IMF chief meets Milei as $57 billion debt bill comes due.
headlines.summary_en: Kristalina Georgieva arrived in Buenos Aires, the capital of Argentina, to personally assess President Javier Milei's economic recovery achievements. Argentine bond prices are currently rising, inflation is declining, and the central bank is rebuilding cash reserves. Georgieva expressed optimism that Argentina may finally break free from the vicious cycle of repeated borrowing and believes no additional IMF financing will be needed before the 2027 presidential election. Argentina will begin repaying principal to the IMF in September, with the repayment plan extending until 2042. A former IMF official said that for Milei to completely escape dependence on the IMF, nearly every factor would need to be flawless.

headlines.title: 世界黄金协会全球研究负责人：美联储重估与AI吸金夹击 东方买盘正重塑定价逻辑
headlines.summary: 【世界黄金协会全球研究负责人：美联储重估与AI吸金夹击 东方买盘正重塑定价逻辑】世界黄金协会（WGC）美洲区首席执行官（CEO）兼全球研究负责人安凯表示，2026年年初至今黄金价格的剧烈波动，是多重宏观驱动力在不同阶段交替主导的结果。全球黄金市场的格局正在发生历史性的结构演变：以中国为代表的亚洲投资者与各大央行正展现出前所未有的支撑力量。黄金市场正在告别由西方单一主导的时代，向更加全球化、多元化的多极定价体系加速迈进。

headlines.title_en: World Gold Council Head of Global Research: Fed Reassessment and AI Fundraising Squeeze, Eastern Buying Reshaping Pricing Logic
headlines.summary_en: [World Gold Council Global Research Head: Fed Reassessment and AI Cash Influx Combine, Eastern Buying Reshaping Pricing Logic] An Kai, CEO of the Americas and Global Research Head at the World Gold Council (WGC), stated that the severe volatility in gold prices so far in 2026 results from multiple macro drivers alternating dominance at different stages. The global gold market is undergoing a historic structural shift: Asian investors, represented by China, along with central banks, are showing unprecedented support. The gold market is bidding farewell to the era dominated solely by the West and accelerating towards a more globalized, diversified multi-polar pricing system.
